'''Panthrakikos Football Club''' ({{langx|el|Α.Π.Σ. Πανθρακικός}}) is a Greek [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Komotini]], [[Thrace]] in North Eastern [[Greece]] founded in 1964. The club competed in [[Super League Greece 2008-09|Super League Greece]] during the 2008–09 season for the first time."}}
